source.title: Some open problems in equivariant infinite-dimensional topology

needs_review.question_text_raw: In this paper we present some open problems in the field mentioned in the title. All problems here discussed arose in the investigation of the author. Special attention is paid to such topics as Extension of equivariant maps, Characterization of G-ANRs, Topology of the Banach-Mazur compacta, Group actions on hyperspaces, and Invariant metric problem.
